then: Selection.Provider is ollama and Tier is empty
Model.ID is llama4:8b with ContextWindow 32768 and MaxOutputTokens 32768
all four prices are 0 and Efforts is nil
Effort is high and Listed is false, with nil error
tests.pseudocode: sel, err = catalog.Select(" Ollama ","llama4:8b","HIGH"); assert err==nil; assert sel.Provider=="ollama" && sel.Tier=="" && sel.Model.ID=="llama4:8b" && sel.Model.ContextWindow==32768 && sel.Model.MaxOutputTokens==32768 && sel.Model.Efforts==nil && sel.Effort==core.EffortHigh && !sel.Listed

tests.title: A maintainer's ollama STANDARD tier with effort xhigh is rejected at load with the failing path
given: the real embedded catalog.json bytes with only the ollama STANDARD tier effort edited to "xhigh"
tests.when: catalog.Parse is called with the edited bytes
then: the *Catalog is nil
errors.As yields a *ParseError with Path vendors.ollama.tiers.STANDARD.effort
errors.Is(err, ErrCorruptCatalog) is true
tests.pseudocode: edited = replaceTierEffort(embeddedBytes, "ollama","STANDARD","xhigh"); c, err = catalog.Parse(edited); assert c==nil; var pe *ParseError; assert errors.As(err,&pe) && pe.Path=="vendors.ollama.tiers.STANDARD.effort"; assert errors.Is(err, ErrCorruptCatalog)

tests.title: An existing embedder builds an agent through the unchanged Lookup and runs one turn with the pre-spec limits
given: the 2026-10-21 embedded catalog
a faux provider client scripted with one text reply
tests.when: agentkit.New is called with Model "claude-sonnet-5-5" and the faux client, and the agent runs one turn
then: the request received by the faux provider has model claude-sonnet-5-5
its output-token cap equals the pre-spec value for the claude-sonnet-5-5 row
the run completes without error
tests.pseudocode: a = agentkit.New(Config{Model:"claude-sonnet-5-5", Client: faux}); a.Run(ctx, "hi"); req = faux.LastRequest(); assert req.Model.ID=="claude-sonnet-5-5"; assert req.Model.MaxOutputTokens == preSpecMax
